_note: Secret Vault water layout, in 1920x1080 pixels. COLOR colours are [r, g, b, a] from 0 to 255; SetColor colours are [r, g, b] from 0 to 1; the name's gradient colours are #RRGGBB text markup; opacities 0 to 1.

surface._note: the rising surface line starts below_screen under the screen's bottom and ends at to_y, out of sight both times

edge._note: the lower edge of the lifting water starts below_screen under the screen's bottom and ends at to_y, out of sight both times

flat._note: the stand-in when the water effect cannot run: the water, and the line along its edge

name._note: a name wider than max_width shrinks to it; a space is space_em font sizes; text_nudge moves the text inside its glyph box

bubbles._note: a bubble rises from start_below under the screen, margin_x or more from the sides, at a scale from scale_min to scale_max; it is dropped above remove_y and shows only surface_margin below the surface and edge_margin above the lower edge
